This opening page of the approved Benziger printing supplies the Easter Preface from Vere dignum through praedicare (w001-w020). Its printed rubric prescribes in hac potissimum nocte for the Easter Vigil. The body continues on p. 237, bound by the separate continuation use; the preceding dialogue is outside this body.

This continuation page of the approved Benziger printing supplies the Easter Preface from cum Pascha nostrum through sine fine dicentes (w021-w066). The following Sanctus and Infra Actionem directions are outside the selected preface body.
